system.requirement: Droids only. Once one or more droid characters have spent significant time together and earned the upgrade…

abilities.description: You have a special bond, and speak in fast-binary that is gibberish to most other droids, and boost one another. Whenever you and your counterpart(s) share a scene together, you cannot get less than a weak hit on a @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a2d7793b23c17489]{Secure an Advantage} roll.
When you and your counterpart(s) @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3de42d2d3cb78855]{Sojourn}, reroll any dice. On a strong hit, take +1 momentum.

If you ever @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff17e67a59539df4]{Face Desolation} while in the presence of your counterpart, add +1. Also, choose two upgrades below that you all have while in one another’s presence.

  • @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.13b2d777c6fb719d]{Gather Information} +1
  • @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.9f538fabf8998c5b]{Compel} +1
  • @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.05909d6310d209a6]{Make a Connection} +1
  • @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.eece9a67d1961f70]{Repair} +1
